conviction_note: No news and no repricing mechanism for a -7.7% fall on 0.69x volume. The one finding is an unfinished seller: per the S-3 of 2026-10-08, 3i's Series B and C preferred convert into about 8.5M shares against 1.95M common outstanding, and the common count rose 51% between Sep 15 and Oct 5. That leans the sign down (p_up 42) on a large own-name move scale (abs 7). The finding's -2.0 is bigger than the scaled -1.12 because the supply story is already visible in an 87% 60-day fall, and the low-volume base rate leans the other way.
bar: This name's own 136 comparable falls (median next close -1.65%, 37.5% up, median abs 4.01%) and phase 0's under-2x-volume conditional (+1.46%), both from the sealed baseline. There is no option chain.

cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: There was no gap. The fall came entirely in the session, on 0.69x normal volume, with no 8-K or press release on 2026-10-12 or 2026-10-13. It continues a fall of -21.5% on 10-12 and -86.7% over 60 sessions, through which 3i, LP has been converting Series B and C preferred: the common count rose from 1,285,731 on Sep 15 to 1,947,783 on Oct 5. A $5M ATM shelf with Rodman & Renshaw was filed on 10-08 and is not yet effective.

evidence.claim: Common shares outstanding were 1,285,731 as of 2026-09-15.
Common shares outstanding were 1,947,783 as of 2026-10-05. Shares issuable on conversion: Series B 3,646,667, Series C 4,828,540. The S-3 also covers a $5M ATM with Rodman & Renshaw.

In the 3i letter agreement of Aug 31, 3i kept $6.137M of a $7.737M purchase for overdue Series C cash true-up payments. A resale registration was owed within 30 days and effectiveness within 60 days (about Oct 30).
On Oct 7, 3i bought another 50 Series B shares ($50,000) under a third side letter, so the program is still feeding preferred.

pipeline.next_dated_event: None inside the window. The 3i resale-registration effectiveness target is about 2026-10-30, from the 8-K of 2026-09-01. The DEF 14A for the reverse-split special meeting is undated. Earnings around 2026-11-13 is a Zacks estimate only.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: An 8-K before the 10-14 close showing a non-dilutive government contract (BARDA or SNS procurement), or showing the 3i conversion program terminated or restructured.

positioning_check: Nasdaq short interest at the 2026-09-30 settlement was 87,968 shares (+128.9% from 38,427 on 09-15), with 1.0 days to cover. That is about 4.5% of the 1,947,783 common shares outstanding on Oct 5. FINRA publishes about eight business days after settlement, so the position carried into this fall is not observable. There is no options market, so there is no skew. Insiders: no open-market buys in 3 or 12 months and one sale. Source: https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/VBIO/short-interest?assetclass=stocks

findings.finding: 3i, LP is a convertible-preferred seller that has not finished. Per the 10-08 S-3, Series B and C convert into 8,475,207 shares against 1,947,783 common. The common count grew 51% between 09-15 and 10-05, and 3i added Series B on 10-07. That supply keeps selling into the 10-14 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: This is a running process, not a dated event. Conversions and resales went on through every session in the record (the share count rose 51% in three weeks) and nothing documented stops them before 10-14. The 8-K of 10-08 shows the program still being funded on 10-07.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Through the conversion period (Aug 20 to Oct 12) this name's comparable falls were followed by next-session moves of +0.82, -1.63, +1.63, -1.07, -4.00, +2.73, +0.48, -10.89, +4.81, +3.19, +0.91 and -7.74. That is 7 of 12 up, with a mean near -0.9: mixed, with fat left tails.
findings.why_not_priced: The fall prices the dilution that has already happened. It does not price the 4.3x as-converted overhang still to clear. The Series B conversion is implied at about $0.78 per share, assuming $1,000 stated value from the 10-07 50-share/$50,000 purchase; that is an inference and leaves 3i in the money at $1.55. If the overhang were held, the stock would trade near the conversion economics and not on a low-volume tape.
findings.independence: The PRE 14A gives an independent count, 1,285,731 shares on 09-15 against 1,947,783 on 10-05 in the S-3. The 09-01 8-K documents $6.1M of overdue true-ups taken by 3i, which shows the instrument resets against the company as the price falls. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1787740/000168316826007588/valion_pre14a.htm

outside_window.finding: The $5M ATM with Rodman & Renshaw is on an S-3 filed 2026-10-08 and not yet effective. As of the baseline seal there was no EFFECT, CORRESP or 424B5 in the submissions feed. Once effective it can sell more than 1.5x today's roughly $3.0M market cap. The effectiveness date is unknown and not shown to fall inside the window.

The 3i resale registration was due for filing about Sep 30, with effectiveness about Oct 30 (commercially reasonable efforts). No resale registration has been filed, so the effectiveness date is about Oct 30.
The PRE 14A seeks reverse-split authority (1-for-2 to 1-for-12) and 272,000 more plan shares, with the meeting date blank. The DEF 14A and the meeting fall after the window.
